WITH base_pop AS (
SELECT DISTINCT lost.client_id AS patient_id
FROM (
    SELECT
        art.client_id,
        MAX(art.return_visit_date) AS return_date
    FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card art
    WHERE art.encounter_date <= :endDate
      AND art.return_visit_date >= DATE_SUB(:startDate, INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
    GROUP BY art.client_id
) lost
WHERE TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, lost.return_date, :endDate) > 28
  AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(
        DAY,
        lost.return_date,
        DATE_SUB(:endDate, INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
      ) <= 28
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary sc
    WHERE sc.client_id = lost.client_id
      AND sc.special_category = 'Current drug user'
)
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM person p
    WHERE p.person_id = lost.client_id
      AND p.dead = 1
      AND p.death_date >= :startDate
      AND p.death_date < :endDate
  )
),
ag AS (
  SELECT
    ag.age_group_id,
    ag.label,
    ag.min_age_days,
    ag.max_age_days,
    ag.sort_order
  FROM report_builder_dim_age_group ag
  JOIN report_builder_dim_age_category ac
    ON ac.age_category_id = ag.age_category_id
  WHERE ac.code = 'MOH_105_OPD_DIAG'
    AND ag.is_active = 1
),
genders AS (
  SELECT 'F' AS gender
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'M' AS gender
),
cnt AS (
  SELECT
    ag.age_group_id,
    mdp.gender,
    COUNT(DISTINCT base_pop.patient_id) AS value
  FROM base_pop
  JOIN mamba_fact_patients_latest_patient_demographics mdp
    ON mdp.patient_id = base_pop.patient_id
  JOIN ag
    ON TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, mdp.birthdate, :endDate)
       BETWEEN ag.min_age_days AND ag.max_age_days
  WHERE mdp.birthdate IS NOT NULL
    AND mdp.gender IS NOT NULL
    AND mdp.gender IN ('F', 'M')
  GROUP BY ag.age_group_id, mdp.gender
)
SELECT
  ag.label AS age_group,
  g.gender,
  COALESCE(cnt.value, 0) AS value
FROM ag
CROSS JOIN genders g
LEFT JOIN cnt
  ON cnt.age_group_id = ag.age_group_id
 AND cnt.gender = g.gender
ORDER BY ag.sort_order, g.gender;
